text:
Welcome to the Hanoi Museum, or Bảo tàng Hà Nội! This striking inverted-pyramid building showcases the rich heritage and development of Thang Long–Hanoi through a variety of artifacts and exhibitions. 

The museum opens its doors from 9 AM to 5 PM. For those looking to explore further, it also extends its hours on Friday and Saturday, welcoming visitors from 5 PM to 9 PM. 

As for the admission fee, it is listed at 50,000 VND for phase two, while phase one was priced at 30,000 VND. However, please note that this fee has not been directly confirmed at the ticket desk, so it’s advisable to check just before your visit.

This museum offers a fantastic glimpse into the history and culture of Hanoi, making it a must-visit for anyone interested in the local heritage. Enjoy your time here!
